title: Restricted-resolution normalization of the specified stalk class map
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, y∈Y, F an O_X-module, p≥0, A=O_{Y,y}, c:Spec A→Y, X′=Spec A×_Y X, f′ the first projection, g′ the second projection, and F′=g′*F. Let C=H^p(X′,F′) with A-scalars through Gamma-Spec followed by f′.appTop, and S=(c_*R^p f′_*F′)_y. Let e:C≃ₗ[A]S be any linear equivalence whose underlying map equals b of [def-weil-pbc-local-direct-image-stalk-class-map] pointwise. For every injective resolution I of F, K of F′, neighborhood V of y and D:FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f c F I K V, set W=g′^{-1}(f^{-1}V). For every xi∈H^p(W,F′|W), the restriction to W of e.symm(germ_V(D.targetClass p xi)) equals xi. The pointwise hypothesis is essential; the statement does not assert this for an arbitrary equivalence.

source.place: Lemma 20.7.3 (Tag 01E4); Remark 20.14.2 (Tag 01FB), computing the map by augmented resolution comparisons; Tag 02OD for the local-spectrum open equality.

proof.text: Mathlib Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk and specialization membership show c inverse image V is top. flatBaseChangeOpenEquality then makes W top.

Prove restriction to top is an isomorphism. Pushforward along the top inclusion is an equivalence, and its restriction unit is invertible. In the concrete cohomology-map data the augmentation square makes beta a quasi-isomorphism. Both complexes are degreewise injective, so Mathlib quasiIso_iff_of_injective makes beta a homotopy equivalence. Global sections sends this to a homotopy equivalence; every factor of the recorded map is invertible.
Apply the inverse of this restriction map to xi, giving eta with r eta = xi. Apply the restriction compatibility theorem and replace r eta with xi by congruence.
Use the pointwise equation e eta=b eta, apply e.symm to the compatibility equality, and apply restriction to recover xi.

theorem localDirectImage_stalk_cohomology_normalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (e : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).toRingedSpace p ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫
            (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).appTop).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)
      ≃ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
      (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).rightDerived
          p).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))))
    (he : ∀ x, e x = localDirectImage_stalk_class f y F p x) :
      ∀ (I : InjectiveResolution F)
        (K : InjectiveResolution
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))
        (V : Y.Opens) (hy : y ∈ V)
        (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (Y.fromSpecStalk y) F I K V)
        (xi : (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
              ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)))),
        Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap
          ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).unit.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)) p
          (e.symm.toLinearMap (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
              (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).rightDerived
                p).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj
                  F))).presheaf V y hy (D.targetClass p xi))) = xi
